text: The enrollment button is rendered as an HTML `<form>` whose `method` attribute is set to **post** — the template in [1] shows `method="post"` for the enroll form. The view that processes the request is built as an `APIView` that implements only a `post()` method and explicitly states that “No other HTTP method will be allowed for this view” — see [3]. Because the operation creates a new enrollment (adds the user to the course’s `students` many‑to‑many relation) and the server only accepts POST, the request must use the POST method, not DELETE.
